name: 7269-mtpdecode-dsv31awq-dp8
model: QuantTrio/DeepSeek-V3.1-AWQ-Lite -- a 671B DeepSeek-V3-architecture MoE at AWQ 4 bit, 361 GB of safetensors. Precision is a fit constraint: this network at blockwise fp8 is ~640 GB and does not fit one 8x80 GB node beside a KV pool. This build also keeps the multi-token-prediction layer (model.layers.61) at the same 4-bit quantization as the rest of the network, where most 4-bit DeepSeek builds stop at model.layers.60; the draft head is resolved from it.
parallelism: TP=8 with attention data parallel over all eight ranks (dp-size 8 == tp-size 8), EP=1, PP=1. One node, no router, no external cache tier.
architecture: DeepseekV3ForCausalLM, 61 layers plus one multi-token-prediction layer (num_nextn_predict_layers 1), hidden 7168, 128 attention heads, MLA with kv_lora_rank 512 + qk_rope_head_dim 64, 256 routed experts + 1 shared at top-8 over 8 groups, moe_intermediate_size 2048, vocab 129280, YaRN to 163840 positions, AWQ 4-bit gemm at group_size 128 with no modules excluded.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=16, warmup the first 25%, bounded at 512 requests with a 2400 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, SINGLE TURN, no prefix structure: prompts centred on 1024 tokens (stdev 128, clamped 640-1408) and generations centred on 256 tokens (stdev 64, clamped 96-512). Radix cache is off, so every request is a real prefill. Seed 0.
purpose: A general chat assistant on a 671B 4-bit model with speculative drafting, 16 concurrent single-turn requests, one eight-GPU node.
launch:
model-path: QuantTrio/DeepSeek-V3.1-AWQ-Lite
trust-remote-code: true

# Required, not optional. The checkpoint declares `quant_method: awq`, and at this engine version
# the plain `awq` path is registered as needing operators from a vLLM install that is not present;
# `moe_wna16` is the in-tree kernel for this checkpoint shape.
quantization: moe_wna16

tp-size: 8
enable-dp-attention: true
dp-size: 8
disable-custom-all-reduce: true

# NEXTN is the checkpoint's own multi-token-prediction layer: the engine resolves the draft weights
# from `model-path` itself, so no separate draft path is named. Do not point one at a separately
# quantized draft repo -- `quantization` is server-wide and the draft config would fail to match.
speculative-algorithm: NEXTN
speculative-num-steps: 2
speculative-eagle-topk: 4
speculative-num-draft-tokens: 4

# Without it this architecture takes the engine's speculative default of 48.
max-running-requests: 256

disable-radix-cache: true
chunked-prefill-size: 16384
cuda-graph-max-bs: 64
context-length: 16384
mem-fraction-static: 0.85

error.text: both versions' own code deadlocks on the first decode step under data-parallel attention with speculative decoding
